payload.title: Count and clear persisted checkpoints through the storage adapter
payload.description:
## Problem

The continuation reset path treats the GraphQL artifact pointer stored in Procedure metadata as if it were an inline checkpoint collection. It reports the number of pointer fields as checkpoints and clears the pointer without using the supported storage protocol.

## Expected behavior

Given procedure checkpoints are stored as authorized artifacts
When an operator resets checkpoints while preserving State
Then the command counts actual execution-log entries
And clears them through the storage adapter
And preserves State, Lua state, dashboard state, optimizer artifacts, and integrity metadata.

## Acceptance

- A behavior test first demonstrates that pointer-field count is not checkpoint count.
- Reset reports the actual number of execution-log entries.
- State remains unchanged and the saved execution log is empty.
- No inline or direct-storage fallback is introduced.
